name: Sanjou Seizou
source:
Husband of Miku. He is the head priest of a temple in the suburbs.

He is a very understanding person who does not show any displeasure when Miku stays at Aoi's mansion for several days returning home.

In fact, he and Aoi seem to get along well, and the whole family gets along well with each other.
